boundary.head: local working tree
boundary.objective: Review the complete latest-version candidate: governed Agent Builder, runtime and profile integration, portable template-agent tools, product-name refresh with compatibility identifiers preserved, disclaimer packaging, documentation, tests, and generated inventory and security evidence.

validation.evidence: Twelve Agent Builder tests passed, including transactional apply, stale-plan rejection, symlink and cycle rejection, Azure Government context, rollback preservation, schema-parity rejection, connection-string rejection, and credential-option rejection.
The mandatory gate scanned 206 files with zero package dependencies, verified 158 checksum-covered release files, passed 119 tests with one platform-specific skip, and verified all 44 skills.
Pinned Gitleaks 8.30.1 passed worktree, staged-index, tracked-report, all-local-ref, and reachable-history scopes with full redaction.
No correctness, security, compatibility, packaging, contract, or test defect remains. CR-0001 and CR-0002 were repaired and reproduced as passing negative regressions.

residualRisks: The focused suite does not exercise simultaneous lock contention between two live apply processes.
Hosted Foundry creation and deployment remain outside this feature and were not assessed.
The release candidate remains unsigned and requires distinct trusted signing and independent-review identities before release.
Hosted CI for the new commit is unavailable until after push.
recommendation: Commit the complete reviewed candidate and push through normal branch protections. Do not sign, publish, deploy, or represent the unsigned candidate as production-ready.
